license_required.quote: a person, partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship shall not engage in the practice of public accounting or hold himself, herself or itself out to the public as an "accountant" or "auditor" ... unless: (a) If a natural person, he or she holds a live permit

issuing_authority.quote: a certificate issued by the Board to a person who is qualified to practice accounting as a certified public accountant

moral_character_required.quote: Is without any history of acts involving dishonesty or moral turpitude

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree with major in accounting or substantially equivalent, plus 150 semester hours
degree_required.quote: At least 150 semester hours or an equivalent number of quarter hours; and a baccalaureate degree or an equivalent degree from a college or university recognized by the Board

accrediting_body.value: college or university recognized by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: a baccalaureate degree or an equivalent degree from a college or university recognized by the Board

required.quote: The requirement for work experience for a certificate of certified public accountant is: (a) Not less than 2,000 hours accumulated over a period of not less than 1 year of public accounting experience

duration.value: Not less than 2,000 hours over a period of not less than 1 year
duration.quote: Not less than 2,000 hours accumulated over a period of not less than 1 year of public accounting experience

kind.value: public accounting experience under direct supervision of a CPA
kind.quote: public accounting experience in a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship engaged in the practice of public accounting under the direct supervision of a person who is a certified public accountant

exams.name: CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board prescribes methods of applying, completing, and grading; may use examination from any approved provider
exams.quote: Has passed the examination prescribed by the Board

interval_years.quote: All permits expire on December 31 of each year and may be renewed annually for a period of 1 year

required.quote: It is in the public interest to require that certified public accountants who have certificates under the provisions of this chapter comply with requirements for continuing education adopted by the Board as a prerequisite to the issuance or renewal of permits

available.quote: The Board may waive the examination, the requirements for education or the requirements for work experience, or any combination thereof, required under NRS 628.190, and may issue a certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant then in effect issued under the laws of any state or other jurisdiction

requirements.value: Must have passed substantially equivalent exam, have CPA experience for more than 4 of the 10 preceding years, and meet education requirements comparable to Nevada's
requirements.quote: The person has passed an examination that is substantially the same as the examination conducted pursuant to NRS 628.230 with a grade that would have been a passing grade in this State on the date on which the person received his or her original certificate

regulatory_model.quote: a person, partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship shall not engage in the practice of public accounting ... unless: (a) If a natural person, he or she holds a live permit

credential_type.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accounting in this State must be issued by the Board to holders of the certificate of certified public accountant

is_mandatory.quote: a person, partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship shall not engage in the practice of public accounting ... unless: (a) If a natural person, he or she holds a live permit

title_protection.quote: A natural person shall not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "C.P.A." or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that he or she is a certified public accountant unless the person: 1. Has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under NRS 628.190 to 628.310, inclusive, holds a live permit

scope_protection.quote: a person, partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship shall not engage in the practice of public accounting ... unless: (a) If a natural person, he or she holds a live permit or has been granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a CPA certificate or permit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or in obtaining a permit to practice public accounting under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence by a CPA or person with practice privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a regulation or rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a regulation or rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board under the authority granted by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty, fraud, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime: (1) An element of which is dishonesty or fraud; or (2) Involving moral turpitude, under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, probation, or refusal to renew authority to practice as CPA by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, placing on probation or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant by any other state, for any cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or probation of right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation or placing on probation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain an annual permit within 60 days of expiration or certificate grant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unless the person has been placed on inactive or retired status, failure to obtain an annual permit under NRS 628.380, within: (1) Sixty days after the expiration date of the permit to practice last obtained or renewed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the profession or reflecting adversely on fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the profession of public accounting or which reflects adversely upon the fitness of the person to engage in the practice of public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement in support of another person's application for a certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement in support of an application for a certificate or permit of another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act in another state or jurisdiction that would be subject to discipline there
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act in another state or jurisdiction which would be subject to discipline in that state.

definition_quote.value: the offering to perform or the performance by a holder of a live permit or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315, for a client or potential client, of one or more services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes
definition_quote.quote: the offering to perform or the performance by a holder of a live permit or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315, for a client or potential client, of one or more services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes

methods_authorized.quote: services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes

value: Audit or other engagement under SAS (AICPA)
Review of financial statement under SSARS (AICPA)
Examination of prospective financial information under SSAE (AICPA)
Examination, review or agreed upon procedures under SSAE (other than prospective financial information examination)
attest_services_types.quote: An audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS) ... A review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) ... An examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) ... An engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) published by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, that is presented in the form of financial statements, of information that is the representation of the owner or management without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: At least 150 semester hours or an equivalent number of quarter hours

ethics_exam_required.quote: The applicant has passed a written examination on national standards for public accounting and ethics that is acceptable to the Board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: A natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to subsection 1 is not required to obtain, as applicable: (a) A certificate pursuant to NRS 628.190; (b) A permit pursuant to NRS 628.380; or (c) A registration pursuant to NRS 628.335.

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board
Comply with provisions of this chapter and Board regulations
Cease practice in Nevada if home-state license becomes invalid or not in good standing
Appointment of home-state board as agent for service of process in Board investigations or proceedings
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: shall be deemed to consent, as a condition of the grant of such practice privileges: (a) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction, and disciplinary authority, of the Board. (b) To comply with the provisions of this chapter and the regulations of the Board. (c) That, in the event that the license or registration from the state wherein the principal place of business of the natural person or certified public accounting firm is located becomes invalid or not in good standing ... (d) To the appointment of the state board that issued the license or registration as the agent upon whom process may be served

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of a corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State, in terms of the financial interests and voting rights of all shareholders, partners, officers, members and principals thereof, must belong to persons who are certified public accountants in any state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State may have as a shareholder, partner, officer, member or principal any natural person who is not a certified public accountant in any state if: (a) The natural person is actively engaged in the business of the corporation, partnership or limited-liability company

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board may provide by regulation for the placing of certificates on a retired or inactive status.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The Board may provide by regulation for the placing of certificates on a retired or inactive status.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each manager in charge of an office of the partnership in this State must be a certified public accountant of this State in good standing.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: A person who, on his or her own behalf or on behalf of a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship, signs or authorizes another to sign an accountant's report on financial statements shall meet the requirements for competency as set forth in the professional standards of accounting.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315 incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by the accountant, except reports submitted by a certified public accountant ... to a client, are the property of the accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Any person who does not hold a live permit from preparing a financial statement or issuing a report if the statement or report, respectively, includes a disclosure that: (1) The person who prepared the statement or issued the report does not hold a live permit issued by the Board; and (2) The statement or report does not purport to have been prepared in compliance with the professional standards of accounting adopted by the Board.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The Board may issue a certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who is the holder of an equivalent certificate then in effect issued by a foreign country if: (a) Persons who are certified as public accountants in this State are granted similar privileges by the foreign country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any such action evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: a partnership, corporation or limited-liability company with an office in this State shall register with the Board if the partnership, corporation or limited-liability company: (a) Performs attest services; (b) Performs compilation services

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: The Board may provide by regulation for the placing of certificates on a retired or inactive status.
